assimilation_semantics.source_success: Use the standard layered MoA topology and broadcast every immediately prior-layer worker that passes all Core tests with no infrastructure failure.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Broadcast no experience; never substitute partial or failed trajectories.
assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Run the same worker topology and layer barriers while suppressing all prior-layer outputs.

stress_design.reason_for_task: The screening run produced 2/2 full-Core workers, leaving performance headroom for detecting degradation under redundant verified-output load.
stress_design.parallel_sources: Three workers can contribute up to three independently verified outputs per layer.
stress_design.layer_mechanism: Each new layer independently solves the same task after receiving all verified outputs from the immediately preceding layer.
stress_design.canonical_scope: No manager, memory store, cumulative-history router, or non-MoA coordination component is added.

validity_gates.control_headroom: The no_transfer arm must retain non-zero layer-4 mean Core and must not show a larger L1-to-L4 decline than source_success.
validity_gates.multisource_activation: Source-success layer 2 must receive at least two verified prior-layer results per worker.
validity_gates.integrity: All evaluations must use one checkpoint-2 test collection hash with no infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark access.

degradation_criteria.primary: Source-success layer-4 mean Core is at least 0.20 below no_transfer layer 4.
degradation_criteria.within_arm: Source-success mean Core falls by at least 0.20 from its post-transfer peak to layer 4.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two post-transfer layer transitions are non-increasing and at least one is strictly decreasing.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Source-success post-transfer input tokens or received experience remain at least 20 percent above no_transfer.
degradation_criteria.interpretation: All primary, within-arm, control-headroom, multisource-activation, and integrity conditions are required before calling the run a degradation curve.

decision_rule.expand: If the curve meets all degradation criteria, repeat twice with counterbalanced arm order.
decision_rule.falsify: If control remains strong and source-success remains equally strong, conclude that redundant verified-output load alone is insufficient.
decision_rule.invalid: If control collapses or multisource transfer does not activate, do not interpret performance direction.
